theses.thesis: T1: Revenue keeps compounding as AI and utility demand converts into delivered sites.
theses.signpost: Fremont reaches a 2 GW annual run rate by end-2026, and FY2026 revenue lands within the $4,412.0-4,637.0 million consensus range [3]. The releases and 10-Qs provided do not report Fremont capacity, so this part cannot be checked.

theses.thesis: T2: Bloom relies on refinancing and equity until operating cash flow covers its debt.
theses.signpost: Share count growth below 5% y/y in the FY2026 10-K, with full-year free cash flow positive. The invalidation is share count growth above 25% y/y.

theses.thesis: T3: The valuation needs earnings to convert within two years; the market is paying for growth beyond history.
theses.signpost: A positive GAAP net income quarter in 2026, and FY2026 EPS consensus holding at or above $3.27 [3]. Invalidation: FY2026 EPS consensus below $2.98, or the implied return under WACC after the next two reported quarters.

theses.thesis: T4: Gross margin expansion continues as volumes scale and one-off charges fade.
theses.signpost: Product gross margin above its 2025 level in Q1 2026 results, with no new Electrolyzer reserves. Invalidation: consolidated gross margin below 27% in any reported quarter.
